profile_text.body:
SoundHound AI, Inc. describes itself as a provider of conversational AI agents for enterprise use. Its website states that the OASYS platform powers voice-native AI agents that resolve service, operations, and commerce conversations for enterprise brands. The site includes customer testimonials citing faster request resolution, improved interaction quality, efficient order processing during peak hours, and always-on voice experiences through hybrid cloud and embedded connectivity.

The company is a for-profit public company headquartered in Claymont, Delaware, trading under the ticker SOUN, with CIK number 0001840856. Court records in Delaware list 33 matters involving the company.
